page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. It features 24 physical cores with a 1-to-1 thread-to-core mapping, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs. The memory configuration consists of 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding 8.0 GB per core. It has no local storage or GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark results place this instance in the middle tier for general compute and memory operations. The system achieved a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1579.68 and a multi-core score of 24990.45. Memory performance is highlighted by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1398.59 GB/sec, which drops to 86.33 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 50.31 GB/sec. In database operations, the server processed 23.38 million Redis SET operations per second and achieved a PassMark database score of 9254.37.

The instance offers high memory density relative to its core count, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. The lack of bundled local storage means all storage operations must traverse the network, which is capped at an 8 Gbps baseline. This server is suited for memory-optimized workloads such as in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation, and general-purpose web serving.
